mapper.select: SELECT RESOURCE_ID, SCHEMA_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, RESOURCE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED FROM DATA_RESOURCE WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = #{schemaName} ORDER BY OBJECT_NAME, RESOURCE_ID
SELECT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME FROM DEPARTMENT ORDER BY DEPT_NAME, DEPT_ID

SELECT #{resourceId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RESOURCE_ID, D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POLICY_ID, P.ACCESS_LEVEL, P.EXPORT_POLICY, P.ENABLED AS POLICY_ENABLED FROM DEPARTMENT D LEFT JOIN DATA_ACCESS_POLICY P ON P.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID AND P.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} ORDER BY D.DEPT_NAME, D.DEPT_ID, P.POLICY_ID

SELECT R.RESOURCE_ID, R.SCHEMA_NAME, R.OBJECT_NAME, R.RESOURCE_NAME, R.DESCRIPTION, R.ENABLED FROM DATA_RESOURCE R WHERE R.SCHEMA_NAME = #{schemaName} AND R.ENABLED = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DATA_ACCESS_POLICY P WHERE P.RESOURCE_ID = R.RESOURCE_ID AND P.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND P.ENABLED = 'Y' ) ORDER BY R.OBJECT_NAME, R.RESOURCE_ID
